questions.question:
다음 대화의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

G: Hi, Jiwoo. What are you planning to do this Saturday?
B: Hi, Emma. I'm planning to go to the museum.
G: That sounds ① boring. Can I go there with ② you?
B: ③ Of course. What time should we ④ meet?
G: Let's meet at 11:00 ⑤ a.m.
questions.explanation: 'That sounds boring'은 박물관을 지루한 것으로 표현하여 부정적인 뉘앙스를 가집니다. 문맥상 "That sounds interesting/fun"이 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Kangmin: I want to be a friend who ⓐ gives honest advice. One of my ⓑ friend was always late. People had to wait for him, and it made everyone ⓒ upset. So, I decided ⓓ to talk to him. "Can you please be on time?" I said. "We want to fully enjoy our time together." Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy. But thankfully, he ⓔ understood. Now he is always on time!
questions.explanation: "One of my friend"는 문법적으로 틀렸습니다. "One of" 다음에는 복수형이 와야 하므로 "One of my friends"가 correct form입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Siyeon: I try to cheer up my friends when they are having a hard time. One day, Jisu posted, "It was a hard day," on her social media. I wanted to do something to ______________________________. So, I bought her chocolate cookies, her favorite snack. Then we watched a movie that had a funny story and took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she felt better.
questions.explanation: 문맥상 Siyeon은 힘들어하는 친구를 도와주고 싶어합니다. 그러므로 친구가 행복하게 느끼도록 만드는 것이 적절합니다: "make her feel happy".

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Bora: I want to be someone ⓐ which is happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both interested in art. When she ⓑ won first prize in the school's art competition, I felt ⓒ jealous. I couldn't congratulate her at first. But I knew she worked really ⓓ hard. Finally, I congratulated her, and she was ⓔ happy about it.
questions.explanation: "someone which is happy"는 문법적으로 틀렸습니다. "someone"은 사람을 나타내는 단수 대명사이므로 주격 관계대명词는 "who"를 사용해야 합니다: "someone who is happy".

questions.question:
대화의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

주어진 문장: Would you like to come with me?

B: Hi, Eunji. What are you doing? ①
G: Hi, Eric. I'm just checking my schedule for tomorrow on my phone. ②
B: I see. What are you planning to do tomorrow? ③
G: I'm planning to exercise at the gym. ④
B: Sure. What time should we meet? ⑤
G: Let's meet at 2:00 p.m. at the gym.
B: Okay. See you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: "Would you like to come with me?"는 운동 계획을 언급한 직후에 나와야 하므로 ④번이 가장 적절합니다. 이를 통해 자연스럽게 만남의 시간을 정하는 대화로 넘어갑니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

Bora: I want to be someone who is happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both interested in art. (A)______ she won first prize in the school's art competition, I felt jealous. I couldn't congratulate her at first. (B)______ I knew she worked really hard. Finally, I congratulated her, and she was happy about it.
questions.explanation: (A)에는 "When"이 적절합니다(시간을 나타냄). (B)에는 "But"이 적절합니다(대조의 의미: 처음에는 축하할 수 없었지만, 그녀의 노력을 알았을 때는 축하했음).

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

주어진 문장: Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy.

Kangmin: I want to be a friend who gives honest advice. One of my friends was always late. ①
People had to wait for him, and it made everyone upset. ② So, I decided to talk to him. ③
'Can you please be on time?' I said. 'We want to fully enjoy our time together.' ④ But thankfully, he understood. ⑤ Now he is always on time!
questions.explanation: "Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy."는 친구에게 말한 후 "But thankfully, he understood"로 이어지기 전에 오는 것이 논리적입니다. 따라서 ④번 위치가 적절합니다.

options: The dog that is running is cute.
I know that he is honest.
It is true that she likes him.
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A) that과 쓰임이 같은 것은?

Siyeon: I try to cheer up my friends when they are having a hard time. One day, Jisu posted, "It was a hard day," on her social media. I wanted to do something to make her happy. So, I bought her chocolate cookies, her favorite snack. Then we watched a movie (A) that had a funny story and took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she felt better.
questions.explanation: (A)의 "that"은 관계대명词로 선행사 "a movie"를 수식합니다. 같은 용법은 "The dog that is running is cute."입니다. 이것도 관계대명사 that이 "dog"를 수식합니다.

options: Did you already pack your bag
Do you want to look at the stars alone
Then why don't you come with us
When are you going to come back home
Why don't you go camping by yourself
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: Hi, Yuna. What are you doing?
G: Hi, Tom! I'm packing my bag. I'm going to go camping with my family tomorrow.
B: Oh, I see. What are you planning to do at the camping site?
G: My family and I are planning to have a barbecue, take a walk, and look at the stars.
B: That sounds really fun. I love going camping.
G: ______________________________?
B: I'd love to! What time should we meet?
questions.explanation: B가 "I'd love to!"라고 응답하므로, G의 질문은 Tom을 캠핑에 초대하는 내용이어야 합니다. "Then why don't you come with us"가 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것을 모두 고르시오.

I try to ⓐ depress my friends when they are having a ⓑ hard time. One day, Jisu ⓒ posted, 'It was a hard day,' on her social media. I wanted to do something to make her ⓓ happy. So, I ⓔ sold her chocolate cookies, her favorite snack. Then we watched a movie that had a funny story and took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she felt ⓕ better.
questions.explanation: ⓐ "depress"는 "cheer up"과 반대의 의미이므로 어색합니다. "cheer up"이 올바른 표현입니다. ⓔ "sold"는 쿠키를 주었다는 의미에서 "bought"가 올바릅니다.

options: Bora being jealous of her friend
Minji working hard for the competition
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A) it이 가리키는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bora: I want to be someone who is happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both interested in art. When she won first prize in the school's art competition, I felt jealous. I couldn't congratulate her at first. But I knew she worked really hard. Finally, I congratulated her, and she was happy about (A) it.
questions.explanation: "she was happy about it"에서 "it"은 Bora가 Minji를 축하(congratulate)한 행동을 가리킵니다. 따라서 "Bora congratulating Minji"가 정답입니다.

questions.question:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 (A)~(C)의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

I want to be a friend who gives honest advice.
(A) Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy. But thankfully, he understood. Now he is always on time!
(B) One of my friends was always late. People had to wait for him, and it made everyone upset.
(C) So, I decided to talk to him. "Can you please be on time?" I said. "We want to fully enjoy our time together."
questions.explanation: 논리적 흐름: 먼저 문제 상황을 설명 (B) → 그 다음 조치를 취함 (C) → 마지막으로 결과를 설명 (A). 따라서 정답은 (B)-(C)-(A)입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

G: Jinsu, what is your hobby?
B: I like to ride my skateboard. It's very fun.
G: Wow, that's cool. I want to (A) [try / avoid] riding a skateboard someday.
B: What are you planning to do this Sunday?
G: I don't have any plans. Why?
B: I'm (B) [planning / stopping] to ride my skateboard on Sunday. I can (C) [teach / learn] you.
G: Great! What time should we meet?
B: Let's meet at 2:00 p.m. at Central Square.
questions.explanation: 문맥상 '스케이트보드를 타보고 싶다'는 의미이므로 (A)는 try가 적절하고, '일요일에 스케이트보드를 탈 계획을 하고 있다'는 의미이므로 (B)는 planning이 적절하며, 상대방을 '가르칠' 수 있다는 의미이므로 (C)는 teach가 적절하다.

options: I don't know who sent this letter.
The girl who is singing is my sister.
Can you tell me who did it?
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A) who와 쓰임이 같은 것은?

Kangmin: I want to be a friend (A) who gives honest advice. One of my friends was always late. People had to wait for him, and it made everyone upset. So, I decided to talk to him. "Can you please be on time?" I said. "We want to fully enjoy our time together." Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy. But thankfully, he understood. Now he is always on time!
questions.explanation: (A)의 who는 관계대명사로 선행사 friend를 수식하는 역할을 한다. 같은 용법은 3번 'The girl who is singing is my sister.'에서 who가 선행사 girl을 수식하고 있다. 다른 보기들의 who는 의문대명사이다.

options: Who is Jiwoo planning to meet this Saturday?
What is Jiwoo's plan for this Saturday?
Which museum are they going to visit?
What time did they decide to meet?
Did Jiwoo accept Emma's request to go together?
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?

G: Hi, Jiwoo. What are you planning to do this Saturday?
B: Hi, Emma. I'm planning to go to the museum.
G: That sounds interesting. Can I go there with you?
B: Of course. What time should we meet?
G: Let's meet at 11:00 a.m.
questions.explanation: 대화에서 Jiwoo는 박물관에 가려고 한다고만 했고, 어느 박물관인지는 구체적으로 언급되지 않았다. 따라서 'Which museum are they going to visit?'에 답할 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것들로 짝지어진 것은?

I want to be someone who is ⓐ happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both ⓑ interested in art. When she won ⓒ last prize in the school's art competition, I felt ⓓ jealous. I couldn't congratulate her at first. But I knew she worked really ⓔ little. Finally, I ⓕ congratulated her, and she was happy about it.
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'last prize'는 '꼴찌상'이라는 의미인데, 문맥상 '1등 상'을 의미하는 'first prize'가 적절하다. ⓔ 'really little'은 '거의 하지 않았다'는 의미인데, 긍정적인 문맥에서 '정말 열심히'를 의미하는 'really hard'가 적절하다.

options: 소녀는 내일 도서관에 갈 계획을 가지고 있다.
두 사람은 내일 오후 1시에 만나기로 약속했다.
Teo는 도서관에서 공부를 하기 위해 소녀를 만난다.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

G: Let's go to the library tomorrow, Teo. I'm planning to borrow a book.
B: Sure. What time should we meet?
G: Why don't we meet at 1:00 p.m.?
B: Okay. See you then.
questions.explanation: 대화에서 Teo가 도서관에서 공부하려고 하는지의 목적이 명시되지 않았다. Teo는 단지 소녀와 만나기로 동의했을 뿐이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Siyeon: I try to (A) [cheer up / look down] my friends when they are having a hard time. One day, Jisu posted, "It was a hard day," on her social media. I wanted to do something to make her happy. So, I bought her chocolate cookies, her favorite snack. Then we watched a movie that had a (B) [boring / funny] story and took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she felt (C) [better / worse].
questions.explanation: 친구를 기운 나게 하려는 의도이므로 (A)는 'cheer up'이 적절하고, 친구를 행복하게 하기 위해 재미있는 영화를 봤을 것이므로 (B)는 'funny'가 적절하며, 결과적으로 친구가 더 나은 상태가 되었으므로 (C)는 'better'가 적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bora: I want to be someone who is happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both interested in art. When she won first prize in the school's art competition, I felt __________. I couldn't congratulate her at first. But I knew she worked really hard. Finally, I congratulated her, and she was happy about it.
questions.explanation: 처음에는 축하할 수 없었다는 것은 부정적인 감정이 있었다는 의미이다. 문맥상 자신도 관심 있는 분야에서 친구가 1등상을 타서 느꼈을 질투심을 나타내는 'jealous'가 적절하다.

options: 소미는 이번 주 일요일에 쇼핑몰에 갈 계획이다.
소년은 어머니에게 드릴 선물을 사야 하는 상황이다.
두 사람은 오후 3시에 버스 정류장에서 만나기로 합의했다.
소년은 소미가 선물을 고르는 것을 도와주기 위해 동행한다.
소년이 먼저 소미에게 만날 시간과 장소를 제안했다.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

B: The weekend is coming. What are you planning to do, Somi?
G: I'm planning to go to the shopping mall this Sunday.
B: Oh, can I go with you? I have to buy a present for my mom.
G: Sure. What time should we meet?
B: How about meeting at 3:00 p.m. at the bus stop?
G: Sounds good. See you there.
questions.explanation: 소년이 동행하는 이유는 자신의 어머니를 위한 선물을 사기 위함이지, 소미가 선물을 고르는 것을 도와주기 위함이 아니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Kangmin: I want to be a friend who gives honest advice. One of my friends was always (A) [late / early]. People had to (B) [wait / leave] for him, and it made everyone upset. So, I decided to talk to him. "Can you please be on time?" I said. "We want to fully (C) [enjoy / waste] our time together." Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy. But thankfully, he understood. Now he is always on time!
questions.explanation: 친구가 항상 늦었으므로 (A)는 'late'가 적절하고, 늦는 친구를 기다려야 했으므로 (B)는 'wait'가 적절하며, 함께하는 시간을 '즐기고' 싶다는 긍정적 의도이므로 (C)는 'enjoy'가 적절하다.

options: Where is the camping site located?
Who is going camping with Yuna?
What activities are planned at the camping site?
What time is Yuna planning to leave for camping?
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?

B: Hi, Yuna. What are you doing?
G: Hi, Tom! I'm packing my bag. I'm going to go camping with my family tomorrow.
B: Oh, I see. What are you planning to do at the camping site?
G: My family and I are planning to have a barbecue, take a walk, and look at the stars.
B: That sounds really fun. I love going camping.
G: Then why don't you come with us?
B: I'd love to! What time should we meet?
G: We are planning to leave at 9:30 a.m. Can you come to my house around 9:00 a.m.?
B: Sure! See you tomorrow!
questions.explanation: 대화에서 캠핑장의 위치에 대해 언급된 내용이 없다. 따라서 'Where is the camping site located?'에 답할 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어와 바꿔 쓰기에 가장 적절한 단어는?

Kangmin: I want to be a friend who gives honest advice. One of my friends was always late. People had to wait for him, and it made everyone [  upset  ] . So, I decided to talk to him. "Can you please be on time?" I said.
questions.explanation: 'upset'은 '화난, 불쾌한'이라는 의미이다. 같은 의미의 단어는 'annoyed(짜증난, 불쾌한)'이 가장 적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

B: The weekend is coming. What are you planning to do, Somi?
G: I'm planning ⓐ to go to the shopping mall this Sunday.
B: Oh, can I go with you? I ⓑ have to buy a present for my mom.
G: Sure. What time should we ⓒ meet?
B: How about ⓓ meeting at 3:00 p.m. at the bus stop?
G: Sounds ⓔ well. See you there.
questions.explanation: 'Sounds'는 감각동사이고, 형용사가 뒤에 와야 한다. 'well'은 부사이므로 'good'이라는 형용사를 써야 한다. 'Sounds good'이 올바른 표현이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A)와 같은 의미가 되도록 문장을 바꾸어 쓸 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

Siyeon: I try to cheer up my friends when they are having a hard time. One day, Jisu posted, "It was a hard day," on her social media. I wanted to do something to make her happy. So, (A) [ I bought her chocolate cookies ] , her favorite snack. Then we watched a movie that had a funny story and took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she felt better.

→ I bought chocolate cookies _______ _______ .
questions.explanation: 'I bought her chocolate cookies'는 'I bought chocolate cookies for her'로 바꿀 수 있다. 'buy + 사람 + 물건'은 'buy + 물건 + for + 사람'으로 나타낼 수 있다.
